independent_audit.scope: No producer imports. Independently bound selected ranks, input hashes, ridge optima, exact confirmed exports, complete recurrence traces, masks, sklearn metrics, matched V5 comparator, lazy routing and participant summaries/gates. Reuses previously passed source receipt; separate-code same-author arithmetic verification.

data_policy: Aggregate metrics, decisions and hashes only. Raw neural features, labels, coefficients, models and sample traces remain local.

later_label_opportunities.definition: Prespecified descriptive counterfactual: max(daily240,daily360) exceeds daily120 and zero by at least0.05 R2; no scorer outcome enters policy.

summary.limitations: Participant bootstrap for cohort; T2 session intervals are descriptive small-N. Observed acceptance fractions are not population safety bounds. Opportunity analysis is a prespecified post-assessment comparison, not an oracle available to the controller.
